$comment: Client-defined hooks for the bro plugin. SessionStart rehydrates beads context (ready work + active drill frame) so a fresh session or post-compaction agent resumes from bd state, not transcript. Commands are best-effort — every hook exits 0 when bro/bd is absent.

SessionStart.command: bd ready 2>/dev/null | head -20; bro drill current 2>/dev/null || true

PreCompact.command: bro drill current 2>/dev/null && echo 'Active drill frame above — resume with `bro drill up --result ...` when done.' || true
